note: derived from the compiled parameters, not from documentation

code.model: conservative unique decoding bound, not a list decoding radius

unique_decoding.model: pessimistic floor: delta = (1 - rate) / 2, provable today

list_decoding.model: conjectured regime the deployed STARK literature analyses under

soundness_bits.honest_reading: the true value lies between the two; no independent analysis of this crate pins it

adversary.interpretation: expected work to produce one accepted false proof

verifier_cost.note: authentication paths only; fold arithmetic is field work, not hashing
